evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build automated checks for missing or duplicated data, schema drift, and anomalies
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by accuracy, reliability, governance, and automated data-quality checks with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Work with the US Hims & Hers financial team, to provide accurate, reliable and well documented data for SEC reporting.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role directly feeds SEC reporting for a publicly listed company (Hims & Hers) and financial capital-allocation decisions, an explicit financial-reporting and regulatory-disclosure context that places this at high.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes existing standardized financial models across 5 markets, established integrations (Netsuite), and coordination with a US public-company financial team for SEC reporting, indicating a mature, specialized financial-data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Accurately model our product COGs and services costs, with our revenue data to build payback models to help inform capital allocation decisions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise financial/technical scope (SEC reporting, COGs modeling, payback models, marketing spend attribution across Google/Facebook/TikTok, Netsuite integration) that shows exactly what the role does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: own the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our financial data and reporting, across all of our brands... Work with the US Hims & Hers financial team, to provide accurate, reliable and well documented data for SEC reporting.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly finance-oriented — SEC reporting, capital allocation, COGs, payback models — with finance and commercial teams as the primary stakeholders.
evidence.autonomy_level: The expectation is full end-to-end ownership: implementation, governance, data quality monitoring, and documentation.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is explicitly framed around full end-to-end ownership of financial data models across all markets and brands, a clear strategic-ownership signal.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The company mentions using AI-assisted tools in recruitment, but no AI skill or tooling is expected of the candidate in their actual analytics engineering work.
evidence.testing_framing: Build automated checks for missing or duplicated data, schema drift, and anomalies
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and validation are framed as an owned responsibility within a dedicated 'Data quality and validation' section with explicit ownership verbs (monitor, validate, build, investigate, maintain), not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: the rigour of our financial tracking data is directly tied to the quality of decision-making within each markets, and the business's ability to correctly allocate capital to each market.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: SEC reporting accuracy, capital allocation risk, and financial data reliability dominate the JD throughout, with explicit regulatory/public-company disclosure stakes, placing this at high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Maintain and improve the accuracy and reliability of our core orders, revenue & refunds models.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by maintain/improve/standardize verbs applied to existing financial models across markets rather than building new infrastructure from scratch, indicating fix/scale.
evidence.loss_aversion: Work with the US Hims & Hers financial team, to provide accurate, reliable and well documented data for SEC reporting — reflects a dominant regulatory/financial-disclosure risk register, placing this at high.
